title: Falmagne–Block–Marschak Random-Utility Characterization
abstract: A full constructive formalization of the Falmagne–Block–Marschak theorem for any finite nonempty alternative set, without a cardinality bound. A normalized stochastic choice rule on all nonempty menus is generated by a single probability distribution over complete strict rankings if and only if all Block–Marschak alternating-sum coefficients are nonnegative. The proof derives Boolean-lattice flow conservation, constructs a finite ranking mixture by positive-path subtraction, and proves exact lower-contour probability identities by Möbius inversion. Compiled adversarial examples show that regularity alone is insufficient.
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
